provided.name: InventoryPhysicalConsequenceReader
provided.rule: Returns minimized accepted physical-consequence identity and relationships only; never exposes Task writer authority.

provided.name: InventoryTaskDependencyProvider
provided.rule: Apply uses caller LLD-05 UnitOfWork and never clones physical-consequence history.

provided.name: RfcInventoryDependencyProvider
provided.transaction: read-only; accepts stable snapshot or current writer read context
provided.rule: One exact Inventory dependency predicate is used by RFC hard-delete preview and commit; Inventory history cannot be deleted or rewritten to manufacture eligibility.

provided.name: InventoryReferenceDependencyValidator
provided.transaction: read-only validation; authoritative guard uses caller LLD-02 UnitOfWork and never mutates/commits
provided.rule: For Contact targets, any active/nonterminal Spare Request whose immutable requester_contact_id matches is BLOCKED; terminal Spare Request requester history remains queryable but is not an active archive blocker. Other Inventory-owned active reference dependencies are classified by the same bounded indexed guard; INDETERMINATE fails closed.

provided.name: InventoryDevicePartReferenceReader
provided.transaction: read-only; current-UnitOfWork read required when participating in resolution commit

provided.name: InventorySiteDependencyValidator
provided.rule: Read-only validation; authoritative guard uses caller UnitOfWork and fails closed.

provided.name: InventoryCommunicationIdentityProvider
provided.rule: Closed trackable target set is Spare Request, RMA and Fault Tag; Communications cannot mutate Inventory lifecycle through this interface.

consumed.name: DevicePartInstalledComponentResolution
consumed.transaction: caller UnitOfWork for mutation; no nested receipt/commit

rules: InventoryReferenceReader remains an LLD-07-local anti-corruption/composition adapter over exact LLD-02/03 readers and is not a multi-owner cross-packet callable interface.
Inventory never owns Task lifecycle; reviewed Task evidence is downstream input only.
Spare Request requester is a reusable LLD-02 Contact relationship fixed at request creation; receiver is a separate logistics role.
No physical Spare Part Unit exists before accepted receipt.
RFC hard-delete dependency classification is read-only and uses one exact predicate for stable preview snapshots and current writer read contexts.
